accuracy.description: Technical correctness of code snippets, API descriptions, and architecture explanations

scale.1: Multiple factual errors or fabricated code
scale.2: Some inaccuracies in code or explanations

clarity.description: How clearly concepts are explained, logical flow of content, appropriate complexity for audience

depth.description: Level of detail in code walkthroughs, coverage of edge cases, and completeness of explanations

scale.5: Deep exploration with insights beyond the obvious

whyExplanations.description: Quality and frequency of explaining WHY design decisions were made, not just WHAT the code does

scale.1: No why explanations, just describes what
scale.4: Good why explanations for most design choices
scale.5: Every design choice explained with clear rationale

conceptMapConnection.description: How well the lesson connects to the broader module architecture and references related concepts
